paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.22% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+0.41%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.20%). Brent crude changed +0.20% to 109.77. Gold changed -3.16% to 4,028.8. Bitcoin changed -4.54% to 80,200.5234. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.988%, a relative move of -2.16%. Among the firms tracked, Blackstone (+10.66%) and Ares Management (+8.74%) moved the most.
